name: Calf Raise
common_faults: partial ROM not achieving full plantar flexion or dorsiflexion
going too fast and losing eccentric control
contraindications: Achilles tendinopathy in acute flare — reduce load and range
resistance_profile: hardest at peak plantar flexion; consistent through the ROM with machine loading

provenance.notes: Standing version emphasizes gastrocnemius (knee extended); seated emphasizes soleus (knee flexed). Calves often require higher volume/frequency due to adaptation. SFR heuristic.
